title: Xanthe and the Tide
author: Ines Coldharbour
blurb: Sable Lockridge, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
